title: Website color appeal and trust in Canada, Germany, and Japan
statement:
Website color appeal affected trust and satisfaction in a study spanning Canada, Germany and Japan, but preferred schemes differed by culture: Germans showed the strongest preference for blue, Canadians appreciated grey more, and yellow was broadly disliked as a website color scheme. (Milena Head)

Options:
- German-market blue: blue-dominant (fits: professional, functional, trusted)
- Canadian-market grey: grey-dominant (fits: neutral, understated, functional)
- Cross-market blend: blue-grey system (fits: neutral, global, professional)
- Yellow test variant: yellow-dominant (fits: bright, optimistic, experimental)
appliesWhen: Applies to: general, ecommerce, b2b. Audience: adults, b2b buyers, general.

source.title: Colour appeal in website design within and across cultures: A multi-method evaluation
source.authors: Dianne Cyr; Milena Head; Hector Larios
